bibliographic.title: Blood oath
bibliographic.author: Janos Biro
bibliographic.description:
An interactive gothic horror tale

Please note: This story was originally written in Portuguese in 1998 as my first creative writing attempt at age 18. The English version has been translated using AI assistance. Thank you for your understanding regarding any language imperfections.

Cover art: "Love and pain" (1895) de Edvard Munch
